facts.fact: Wavemaker's REST API endpoint is POST /api/v1/videos and is available on the Pro plan ($99/mo) and above.
facts.quote: The API lives at `/api/v1/videos` and is available on the **Pro plan ($99/mo) and above**.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's Business plan costs $299/mo and adds webhooks, higher throughput allowances, and up to 4K export.
facts.quote: Business ($299/mo) adds webhooks, higher throughput allowances, and up to 4K export if you need it.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's API rate limit is 30 requests per minute.
facts.quote: | Rate limit | 30 requests per minute |

facts.fact: Wavemaker streams video render progress updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
facts.quote: | Progress updates | Server-Sent Events (SSE) progress streaming |

facts.fact: On the Business plan, Wavemaker sends HMAC-signed webhooks to notify when a video completes.
facts.quote: | Completion notification | HMAC-signed webhooks (Business plan) |

facts.fact: Wavemaker's API supports aspect ratios 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5, plus 2:3 via the API.
facts.quote: | Aspect ratios | 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, plus 2:3 via API |

facts.fact: Generating a Wavemaker video of about 30 seconds costs 75 credits.
facts.quote: | ~30-second video | 75 credits |

facts.fact: Generating a Wavemaker video of about 60 seconds costs 150 credits.
facts.quote: | ~60-second video | 150 credits |

facts.fact: Editing or refining an existing Wavemaker video costs 15 credits.
facts.quote: | Edit / refine an existing video | 15 credits |

facts.fact: Generating a single Wavemaker image costs 3 credits.
facts.quote: | Generate a single image | 3 credits |

facts.fact: Exporting a Wavemaker video at 480p is free.
facts.quote: | Export at 480p | Free |

facts.fact: Exporting a Wavemaker video at 720p costs 5 credits.
facts.quote: | Export at 720p | 5 credits |

facts.fact: Exporting a Wavemaker video at 1080p costs 10 credits.
facts.quote: | Export at 1080p | 10 credits |

facts.fact: Exporting a Wavemaker video at 4K costs 25 credits.
facts.quote: | Export at 4K | 25 credits |

facts.fact: The Pro plan includes 2,000 credits per month with 20% rollover, which Wavemaker says covers roughly 26 thirty-second videos.
facts.quote: Pro gives you 2,000 credits a month with 20% rollover, which covers roughly 26 thirty-second videos.

facts.fact: The Business plan includes 8,000 credits with 50% rollover.
facts.quote: Business gives you 8,000 credits with 50% rollover.

facts.quote: credit packs start at $9.99 for 100 credits
